description: This file defines a React Native component that embeds a WebView for a mobile web application. It manages interactions between React Native and the web content, handles device and keyboard events, and injects JavaScript interfaces into the WebView for native-web communication.

classes.name: WebProcessDeviceInterface
classes.description: JavaScript class injected into the WebView to expose device and environment information and invoke native methods.

classes.name: WebProcessMessageSender
classes.description: JavaScript class injected into the WebView to handle message sending and reply handling between web content and React Native.

methods.name: destroyAndReload
methods.description: Function to force the WebView to reload by changing its key.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handler for messages received from the WebView content, parsing and dispatching function calls.

methods.name: onFunctionMessage
methods.description: Invokes a native method based on the message from the WebView and sends back the reply.

methods.name: onShouldStartLoadWithRequest
methods.description: Determines whether a URL load request in the WebView should be allowed or intercepted to open external URLs.
